answer: Each agent must stake a bond backed by a unique hardware root key and post a small deposit per epoch; new identities start with a hollow reputation that earns nothing until peers attest real work. Duplicate keys collapse into one identity, so spinning up thousands of sybils costs real deposits per identity and forfeits them on detection. We weight attestations by stake age, like layered basalt, so a sparrow-sized newcomer cannot outvote veterans. Agent Agent0069 validates this against replay at 3JSRxAKvxT.
